codeReview.summary: The feature adds substantial policy/claim-gate machinery and tests, but several contract-critical checks are either missing or too weak to enforce the stated guarantees across local/nightly/manual evidence.

issues.description: VAL-BENCH-012 requires evidence to be on the same commit and manifests, but the gate validates only commit SHA consistency and never validates manifest-hash consistency across runs (despite ingesting manifest_hashes). This can pass mixed-manifest evidence sets.

Claim-threshold evaluation is derived from local-run stats only (primary_stats = local) and cross-run logic only checks direction agreement (<1.0), not threshold satisfaction per run type. This does not enforce that threshold rules pass for local + nightly + manual runs as required by VAL-BENCH-012.

Order-bias validation marks pass whenever execution_schedule exists, without enforcing declared schedule semantics (e.g., interleaved_random) or validating seed/entry integrity against policy. Fixed-order schedules can incorrectly pass VAL-BENCH-010.

The measured CLI exits non-zero only on cell execution errors; it does not fail when sampling validation returns FAIL. This weakens policy enforcement because non-compliant warmup/sample/order runs can still exit successfully.

summary: Reviewed handoff, commit diff, transcript skeleton, and benchmark-worker skill. Marked FAIL due to missing manifest-consistency enforcement and incomplete cross-run threshold enforcement in claim gating, plus insufficient order-bias enforcement and measured-command non-failing behavior on sampling gate failures.
